rules.title: Rules
items: Warm-up|5–8 minutes of light cardio plus 1–3 warm-up sets of the first exercise. They don't count as working sets.
Intensity|Finish most sets with 1–3 reps in reserve. You don't need to go to failure every time.
Progression|Hit the top of the range in every set with clean form? Add a little weight and start again from the bottom of the range.
Rest|Compound lifts (presses, rows, leg press): 2–3 minutes. Isolation: 60–120 seconds.
Recovery|Very sore, form getting worse, or joints aching? Move the workout to another day.
Missed days|Missed a couple of days? Don't start over, just continue with the next workout.
rules.stopText: Sharp pain, joint pain, numbness or any unusual sensation: stop the exercise and find out the cause.

install.title: Install
install.openHome: Open Simple Training from your Home Screen.

gate.title: Install Simple Training
gate.lead: Add the app to your Home Screen first. It takes about half a minute.
why: Works offline, even with no signal at the gym.
Opens full screen, like a regular app.
Your data stays in the app on your phone.
gate.warn: Data in the browser and in the installed app are separate and don't carry over. Use the installed app so your workouts aren't lost.
gate.translated: Menu items are named in English here; on your phone they may be translated.
gate.profileNote: Fill in your profile in the installed app: the browser tab and the installed app keep separate data.

ios27.menu: Tap the button with three lines (≡) to the left of the address bar at the bottom of the screen.
ios27.menuNote: It’s at the bottom, next to the address bar.
ios27.share: In the menu that opens, tap “Share”.
ios27.more: Tap “View More” — the button with a down arrow to the right of “Copy”, “Add to Bookmarks” and “Add to Reading List”.
ios27.moreNote: The full list of actions opens.
ios27.add: Tap “Add to Home Screen” (a plus in a square).

ios.dots: Tap “⋯” next to the address bar.
ios.shareAlt: If your tabs are at the bottom or top of the screen (“Bottom” or “Top” layout), the “Share” button is right on the bar.
ios.shareOld: Tap “Share” (a square with an arrow up) on the bar at the bottom.
ios.shareEither: Tap “Share” (a square with an arrow up): in the “⋯” menu next to the address bar, or right on the bar at the bottom.
ios.lookHere: If you don't see it in one place, look in the other.
ios.addHome: Scroll down the list and tap “Add to Home Screen”.
ios.editActions: Not in the list? Tap “Edit Actions” at the very bottom and add it.
ios.webApp: Keep “Open as Web App” turned on, then tap “Add”.
ios.addOld: Tap “Add” in the top right corner.
ios.continueNote: Data in Safari may be deleted after 7 days without use.

legal.adultLabel: I am at least 16 years old and I accept the {terms} and the {privacy}
legal.adultRequired: To continue, confirm that you are at least 16 and accept the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy.
legal.disclaimer: Strength training has risks. You choose your exercises and weights and train at your own risk. If you have a health concern, an injury or a condition, are pregnant or unsure, talk to a doctor first. Tips and warnings in the app are general information, not medical or professional advice.
legal.weightWarnTitle: This is a very heavy weight
legal.weightWarnBody: This is a very heavy weight. The app does not recommend it; you do it at your own risk. A warning, or no warning, does not mean a weight is safe for you.
legal.backupReminder: Save a copy so you don't lose your progress.
legal.backupReminderNote: The file is not encrypted. You choose where to keep it.
legal.backupNote: A copy is a readable JSON file: it is not encrypted and is not sent to us. You choose where to save it (Files, iCloud Drive, email…). Keep it somewhere secure and delete copies you no longer need.
legal.deleteBody: This deletes your profile, plan, workout history, notes and settings stored in this browser. It cannot be undone, and we cannot recover it. Save a copy first if you need your data.
legal.restoreBody: Your current profile, plan, history and settings will be replaced by the data from this file. You can undo this until you change anything. Restore checks the file, but you are responsible for choosing it.
legal.englishOnly: Legal documents are only available in English for now. If translations differ, the English version prevails.
legal.licensesLead: Simple Training uses open-source software and fonts. Their licences are listed below.
legal.updatedBody: Please review the updated Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. You can read them first; to keep using the app, accept them.
legal.responsible: Fovae, a project of Vladyslav N.
